Face Liveness is determined with a probabilistic calculation, and then a confidence score (between 0–100) is returned after the check. The higher the score, the greater the confidence that the person taking the check is live. Face Liveness also returns a frame, called a reference image that can be used for face comparison and search. As with any probability-based system, Face Liveness cannot guarantee perfect results.
